evidence.quote: Pickup is our online ordering service.
Simply shop online for the products you need and pick up your order at the store you choose!
We offer several ways to shop for groceries online.
A delivery driver will drop your groceries off on your doorstep.
Check off your grocery list and earn cash back at most grocery stores and supermarkets.

draft.notes: Kroger also operates fuel centers: U.S. Bank says locations may qualify in gas and/or grocery, while Citi lists Kroger among supermarkets excluded from its gas earn rate. The site primarily describes grocery shopping, pickup, and delivery, so supermarkets is the best single category.
